labeling: Synthetic policies/queries and relevance labels authored by coding agent. No independent human adjudication.
lexical_semantics: Legacy all uses AND plainto_tsquery and retains zero-score ranks. New any uses parameterized OR websearch terms and excludes zero-score lexical entries from ranking/fusion. No main pipeline configuration is changed.
latency_scope: Warm retrieval with a new scoped runtime-role transaction per query; local CPU/PostgreSQL. Excludes fixture seed, routing, generation and provider calls.
limitations: 32 agent-authored synthetic queries,16 per split; no independent human relevance adjudication or representative traffic sample. Ranking comparison does not establish answer factuality or retrieval abstention on unknown topics. Main demo still retains its previous corpus/retrieval release.
